text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
November ▲ | Post-Race | Wind: Relentless 
Gale "Setting Sail for the Open Sea Once 
More!" ====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
We did it! Our running conquered the Japan 
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
I made my appeal from the Winner's Circle! 
I asked the crowd for their cheers, and 
the wealthy watching around the world for 
a chance!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
We've done what needs to be done. All 
that's left is the finishing blow. To open 
up the sea route to the world, let's go 
wild for the last time this year at the 
"Arima Kinen"!
